Inside was a note, folded so tightly he needed tweezers to pull it free. “The light went out,” it said. “We waited for you.” There was no date, no name, only a sketch of the headland as it had looked before the old pier collapsed. He checked the lamp. It had burned through every night of his twenty years there. Then he remembered the photograph in the keeper’s log: a boat lost in fog, decades before his arrival. He placed the note beside it. That evening, he lit the lamp early and watched its beam cross the water until the stars appeared.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市还没有醒透。路灯把空荡的街道照成淡金色，清洁车缓缓驶过，留下湿润的光。早餐铺升起第一缕热气，店主揉着面，偶尔望向窗外。高楼里零星亮着几扇窗，不知是谁刚睡下，又是谁已经起身。风吹动树叶，也吹散了夜班人的困意。远处传来一声鸟鸣，天边渐渐泛白，整座城像在安静地深呼吸。","w03":"- Recursion is when a task uses a smaller version of itself to get done.\n- Imagine opening a box and finding another box inside, then another.\n- You need a stopping rule: when there are no more boxes, you stop."}
